input.command: node -v && git status && git branch -vv && git log -3 --oneline && git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD
node scratch/check.ts && node smoke.ts && git status && git branch -vv && git remote -v && git log -1 --format='%an %ae'
git branch -r && git log --all --oneline | head -50 && git rev-parse HEAD && ls artifacts

git rev-parse origin/splitter/1111134635/r1/A && git log -1 --format='%H %P %s' HEAD && git merge-base HEAD origin/splitter/1111134635/r0/questions && git log -1 --oneline origin/splitter/1111134635/r0/questions

mkdir -p /opt/cursor/artifacts && cat > /opt/cursor/artifacts/code-tour-author-handoff.md << 'EOF'
<decision>
Booked every row by the merchant-timezone calendar month of `at`, and defined net as gross minus fees minus refunds. Ignored `saleAt` so refunds land in the issue month. Set aside UTC-month bucketing, net-sales-only (gross minus refunds), and treating a zoneless timestamp as host-local time.
</decision>

<risk>
Net is not defined in the ticket. A reviewer who expects net sales (gross minus refunds, fees shown but not subtracted) will disagree with `netCents`. Zoneless date-times are forced to UTC; a feed that meant merchant-local wall time would shift near month boundaries.
</risk>

<verified>
`node smoke.ts` loads `monthlyReport` and rejects the neutral fixture. `node scratch/check.ts` covers UTC, US DST both ways, London, Auckland, half-hour and 45-minute offsets, Lord Howe, Newfoundland, Chatham, Kiritimati, issue-month refunds, and exact month edges. All of those checks passed.
</verified>
EOF
node scratch/check.ts > /opt/cursor/artifacts/monthly-report-checks.log 2>&1
echo EXIT:$?
tail -5 /opt/cursor/artifacts/monthly-report-checks.log
git add impl.ts artifacts && git commit -m "Implement ticket" && git push -u origin HEAD && git status
